summary: Build practical skills in safety risk analysis, FMEA, incident trends, and dashboards. Explore the five-day course and review the outline.
lede: Safety data analytics and risk management helps health and safety professionals use workplace safety records to prioritize controls. Officers, analysts, and operations supervisors practise data-quality checks, risk scoring with FMEA and Bowtie analysis, incident-trend review, and dashboard design in Excel and Power BI. AI-assisted anomaly detection is introduced conceptually, with human review and reliable data emphasized when reporting control priorities.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who review workplace safety data, assess operational hazards, or turn risk findings into corrective actions and management reports.
prerequisites: Prior experience with workplace safety, operational risk, incident records, or health and safety reporting is recommended. Basic spreadsheet skills are useful. Coding or programming is not required; AI-assisted analytics is covered at a conceptual awareness level.
